messages:
emma_cs: Quick ping — Newton Analytics procurement submitted a renewal amendment request that mixes a few tricky asks: move billing for the 20 added seats to their Ireland entity (Newton EMEA Ltd), change invoice currency to EUR for that entity, extend term to 18 months (they want 6mo bonus term), and they insist the Ireland amendment be wet-signed while the US side can use e-sign. Need feasibility + timing.
raj_sales: Got it. Currency switch to EUR is possible but Finance needs confirmation of remit currency and FX handling. Term extension to 18 months affects ARR recognition; will need accounting signoff. Do they want the 6mo bonus tacked on top of current expiry or replace current term length?
carla_billing: Currency per-entity ok. We'll invoice EMEA in EUR if they provide IBAN + billing remit. For proration we need effective date. Wet-sign for Ireland: we'll accept scanned PDF of wet page attached to the amendment — Legal to confirm. Also need correct VAT/Tax ID for Ireland entity.
oliver_legal: Wet-sign accepted for Ireland only if scanned signature page is from an authorized signatory and includes a short attestation. I'll add clause: "Scanned wet signature page bearing the authorized signatory's signature shall be binding for the Ireland amendment." E-sign remains acceptable for US amendment.
emma_cs: Customer says: effective add date = 2024-07-01, seats added = 20, seat rate = 1,250 USD/seat/yr (they asked to bill EMEA in EUR at equivalent rate). They want the 6mo extension to run after current term (so term end moves forward).
raj_sales: Pricing impact: 20 * 1250 = $25,000/yr -> for 18 months pro-rated = $37,500 pre-FX. Need manager sign-off for term extension incentives; also they asked for a $5k onboarding credit if they sign by 2024-06-15. Manager ok if credit conditional on signature by that date.
carla_billing: To generate EUR invoices we'll convert USD total using close-of-day FX on invoice date and include both USD and EUR lines for transparency. For Ireland VAT: if they provide VAT ID, we'll zero-rate if applicable. Need PO mapped to Newton EMEA Ltd for the EMEA invoices.
oliver_legal: I'll prepare two amendment attachments: (1) seat add + currency/billing mapping, (2) term extension + onboarding credit conditions. Add attestation: "Signer attests authority to bind Newton EMEA Ltd." Also include a mapping table for PO numbers vs legal entities.
docu_sign_bot: DocuSign envelope prepared: newton-2024-multi-entity. Envelope set: US flow = e-sign, EMEA flow = manual upload for scanned wet-sign.
emma_cs: I'll ask procurement for: (a) IBAN + remit address + VAT for Newton EMEA Ltd, (b) scanned signatory name/title for wet sign, (c) PO number for EMEA. Target timeline: draft to customer by 2024-06-03, return signed by 2024-06-12 to hit onboarding credit window.
raj_sales: Noted. I'll include the $5k credit clause: "Credit applied to first EMEA invoice on receipt of signed amendment by 2024-06-12; otherwise credit void."
carla_billing: I'll prepare sample invoice lines and FX note. If PO references old legal name, finance will need corrected PO before issuing EMEA invoice.
emma_cs: Customer already uploaded a draft PO with old parent name. I'll push them to correct and request scanned signatory early. If they balk on wet-sign courier, Legal will escalate.
oliver_legal: Accept scanned wet signature by email. Physical courier only if customer insists and Legal will advise.
docu_sign_bot: Status: envelope newton-2024-multi-entity queued. Manual upload placeholder for EMEA signer ready.
emma_cs: Thanks team — I'll post updates. If procurement asks for a mapping sheet, I'll attach the PO->entity table. :thumbsup:
